author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description: How do you move a camera across 70 feet of track and hit the same mark each time? ILM’s John Knoll introduces #AdamSavage to his latest #motioncontrol rig — yet another engineering marvel — for the #RazorCrest in #StarWars #themandalorianandgrogu. Did you ever wonder how this sort of movie magic happens?
title: How Motion Control Rigs Repeat Film Shots #StarWars
